description: This Java source file defines a set of converter classes for transforming between JSON objects and GenericValue entities, as well as collections and null representations, within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: Main class implementing ConverterLoader, providing methods to load various converters for entity and JSON transformations.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained converters into the conversion framework.

classes.name: JSONToGenericValue
classes.description: Converts JSON objects into GenericValue entities, reconstructing entity fields from JSON data.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs conversion from JSON to GenericValue, handling type casting and entity field setting.

classes.name: GenericValueToJSON
classes.description: Converts GenericValue entities into JSON objects, including delegator and entity name metadata.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs conversion from GenericValue to JSON, serializing entity fields.

classes.name: GenericValueToList
classes.description: Wraps a single GenericValue into a List collection.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a GenericValue into a List containing that value.

classes.name: GenericValueToSet
classes.description: Wraps a single GenericValue into a Set collection.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a GenericValue into a Set containing that value.

classes.name: GenericValueToString
classes.description: Converts a GenericValue to its string representation.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Returns the string form of the GenericValue.

classes.name: NullFieldToObject
classes.description: Converts a NullField marker to a null Object.

classes.name: ObjectToNullField
classes.description: Converts an Object to a NullField marker.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Returns a NullField marker for any Object.
